recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future work would only be needed if a work group defines a dedicated SampledData search type and decides to reintroduce explicit SampledData indexing semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-48633 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 change request reporting that SampledData was listed as not used in search even though Observation combo-value-quantity and component/value-quantity search parameters still described and indexed SampledData bounds. The accepted resolution removed SampledData from those Observation quantity search parameter descriptions and expressions.
initial_application: Commit 4628e558178cb6196743b3cafab9cb255533da6e changed source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml to remove SampledData from combo-value-quantity, component-value-quantity, and value-quantity. That commit did not mention FHIR-48633, so this reconciliation publishes an audit record tying the existing source state to the issue.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active observation=Observation resource entry, so the Observation search parameter bundle is in current build scope. source/search.html still marks SampledData as Not used in search, and Confluence minutes from FHIR-I/OO support the rationale that core does not define SampledData search semantics.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active Observation search parameter definitions now contain only Quantity expressions for the three affected parameters and no SampledData bounds prose, making the search page matrix internally consistent.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final requested source state for the seed issue.

evidence_items.learned: The active source already implements the Jira resolution.

evidence_items.summary: The SampledData row in the search page matrix says Not used in search.

evidence_items.summary: The May 2025 commit modified source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml to remove SampledData from the affected descriptions and expressions.

evidence_items.locator: FHIR-I WGM 202501 and OO on FHIR 2025-04 minutes
evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes say core has no SampledData search type and should not allow SampledData in search FHIRPath; OO minutes say FHIR-I does not provide sampledData searches in core.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports the choice to remove SampledData rather than change the search matrix to permit it.

evidence_items.command: rg -n '^observation=Observation$' source/fhir.ini; rg -q 'ofType\(SampledData\)|as SampledData|bounds of the values in sampled data' source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml; rg -n '<%xcmchk SampledData%>Not used in search' source/search.html
evidence_items.summary: Observation is active, the Observation search parameter bundle has no SampledData search expression or bounds prose, and the search page still marks SampledData as not used in search.
evidence_items.learned: The current source is already consistent with FHIR-48633, so an empty no-change audit commit is appropriate.

evidence_items.summary: A 2018 thread discussed the old inconsistency between Observation SampledData quantity search text/expressions and the search page's claim that SampledData is not used in search.
evidence_items.learned: The thread explains the historical inconsistency but does not override the later Applied/Persuasive R6 removal decision.
